components.name: Source Note
components.description: Dashed unfilled note under the dark Standby Insights tab; the signature container on panel and cards.
components.html:
Unit 4B, Harbor House

Checked Sep 14, 9:02 AM
components.css: .ds-note { position: relative; padding: 22px 16px 16px; border: 1px dashed #a7b0b2; background: transparent; color: #2d3538; font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-note::before { content: 'Standby Insights'; position: absolute; left: 12px; top: -10px; padding: 1px 8px; background: #22343a; color: #eef3f2; font: 700 10px/1.8 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-note-title { margin: 0; padding-top: 10px; font: 600 19px/1.3 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-note-meta { margin: 0; color: #5d686b; font: 12px/1.5 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Borderless mono action (Refresh) with a 44px target.
components.css: .ds-text-action { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 2px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #2d3538; font: 500 12px/1 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-action:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2d3538; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-text-action:disabled { color: #5d686b; cursor: wait; text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Standby-Only Headline
components.description: Mono answer line that turns deep green behind a green square when standby-only.
components.html:
3 standby-only nights in your window

Sep 18 to Sep 21
components.css: .ds-headline { margin: 0; color: #2d3538; font: 600 16px/1.35 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-headline[data-standby-only='true'] { color: #0f6e52; } .ds-headline[data-standby-only='true']::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; margin-right: 8px; vertical-align: 1px; background: #1d9e75; } .ds-headline-detail { margin: 2px 0 0; color: #5d686b; font: 12px/1.45 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Six-Week Grid Days
components.description: Day cells: green standby-only, hatch reserved, inset outline move-in, dots not returned, outlined today, corner-marked check-in.
components.html: 14151617181920
components.css: .ds-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2px; forced-color-adjust: none; } .ds-day { position: relative; min-height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #2d3538; font: 12px/1.1 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-day[data-kind='standby-only'] { background: #1d9e75; color: #04261b; font-weight: 700; } .ds-day[data-kind='reserved'], .ds-day[data-kind='blocked'] { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #b4bcbe 0 1.5px, #f1f3f3 1.5px 4px); text-shadow: 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 3px #fff; } .ds-day[data-kind='move-in'] { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #8a9598; } .ds-day[data-kind='not-returned'] { background: radial-gradient(circle, #8a9598 .9px, transparent 1.3px) 0 0 / 4px 4px; text-shadow: 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 3px #fff; } .ds-today { outline: 2px solid #2d3538; outline-offset: 1px; z-index: 1; } .ds-check-in::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; right: 2px; border: 4px solid transparent; border-top-color: #2d3538; border-right-color: #2d3538; }

components.name: Dashed Section
components.description: Secondary section outside the note: dashed top rule and uppercase mono label.
components.html:
Unit and building facts

Second floor, walk-up.
components.css: .ds-section { padding: 20px 0 22px; border-top: 1px dashed #a7b0b2; } .ds-section-label { margin: 0 0 12px; color: #5d686b; font: 700 11px/1.5 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-section-body { margin: 0; color: #2d3538; font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Price Comparison
components.description: Two mono price columns split by a dashed vertical rule.
components.css: .ds-prices { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin: 0; } .ds-prices > div + div { border-left: 1px dashed #a7b0b2; padding-left: 16px; } .ds-prices dt, .ds-prices dd { margin: 0; color: #5d686b; font: 12px/1.45 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-prices dd.ds-price { margin: 2px 0; color: #2d3538; font: 600 26px/1.2 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: -.02em; }

components.name: Facts Row
components.description: Mono label and value on a light dashed divider, with an optional sans caveat.
components.css: .ds-facts { margin: 0; } .ds-facts > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.6fr); border-bottom: 1px dashed #d3d8d9; } .ds-facts > div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-facts dt { padding: 7px 12px 7px 0; color: #5d686b; font: 12px/1.5 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-facts dd { grid-column: 2; margin: 0; padding: 7px 0; color: #2d3538; font: 13px/1.5 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-facts dd + dd { padding-top: 0; color: #5d686b; font: 13px/1.45 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Standby Strip
components.description: Card annotation: six weeks condensed to a 10px bar with today edge, check-in triangle and week dividers.
components.css: .ds-strip { position: relative; display: flex; height: 10px; margin: 9px 0 3px; forced-color-adjust: none; } .ds-strip > span { flex-basis: 0; min-width: 0; } .ds-strip::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent calc(100% - 1px), #fff 0) 0 0 / calc(100% / 6) 100%; } .ds-strip::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: -3px; bottom: -3px; width: 1.5px; background: #2d3538; z-index: 1; } .ds-strip [data-kind="standby-only"] { background: #1d9e75; } .ds-strip [data-kind="reserved"] { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #8a9598 0 1.5px, #fff 1.5px 4px); } .ds-strip [data-kind="move-in"] { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #8a9598; } .ds-strip [data-kind="not-returned"] { background: radial-gradient(circle, #8a9598 .8px, transparent 1.2px) 0 0 / 3px 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Standby Insights lives on someone else's page. On Landing's listing cards it appears as a small dashed note under a dark tab that names the source; in the side panel it is that same note, opened up to hold the full answer. The two surfaces are one system: white ground, a 1px dashed outline that is never filled, a dark square tab reading "Standby Insights", and monospace for everything that is data. Nothing Landing draws looks like this, so nothing here reads as theirs, and nothing here outweighs the listing itself.

Density is quiet and tabular. The note holds what a member screened for (unit, check time, the standby-only headline, a six-week grid). Everything after it (prices, facts, location) sits outside the note in sections separated by dashed rules, one step quieter. Status always lives in words; color, hatch, outline and dots repeat those words as a picture and never replace them.

This system replaces the Scout / Picture Desk panel (petrol ink, Archivo display face, outline icons) shaped on 2026-09-12. That direction is superseded history only; its capture is `.impeccable/mocks/panel-scout-icons.png`.
keyCharacteristics: Dashed, unfilled note under a dark square source tab, on both card and panel.
Monospace for tabs, labels, headings, dates, prices and grid numerals; system sans only for caveat prose.
One accent (standby-only green); every other state is a texture: hatch, outline, dots.
Square corners everywhere. No elevation, no icons, no web fonts.
Hierarchy by dashed rules and gray steps, not by boxes or fills.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green appears only where a day or answer is standby-only. It is never a brand color, a link color, a button fill or a success state.

rules.name: The Texture Not Hue Rule
rules.body: Every non-standby-only state is drawn as a texture in grays: hatch for reserved or blocked, a 1px inset outline for standard move-in, dots for not returned. Missing data is dotted, never blank and never outlined like move-in.

rules.name: The Words First Rule
rules.body: A state is always named in text; the grid, strip and legend repeat it. The calendar grid is `role="img"` with a text alternative, and the legend is decorative.

rules.name: The Mono For Data Rule
rules.body: If a member might compare it across units (a date, a price, a count, a label, a numeral), it is monospace. Sans is reserved for caveat sentences such as fact notes and disclosures.

rules.name: The System Faces Rule
rules.body: No web fonts, no bundled font files. The stacks above are the whole type inventory.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing lifts off the page. A box-shadow or text-shadow is allowed only when it draws a mark or protects legibility, never when it suggests elevation.

dos: Do open every Standby Insights surface with the dashed note and the dark "Standby Insights" tab, so attribution is in words.
Do set dates, prices, labels and grid numerals in the mono stack; use system sans only for caveat sentences.
Do reserve Standby Green for standby-only days and answers, and draw every other state as hatch, inset outline or dots.
Do name each state in text and let the grid, strip and legend repeat it.
Do separate secondary sections with 1px dashed rules in Dash Gray, and drop a rule when its section renders nothing.
Do keep text actions borderless mono with a 44px target, a hover underline and a 2px solid focus outline.
Do keep numerals legible over textures with the white halo, and stack fact rows at 380px and prices at 260px.
donts: Don't fill the note, round a corner, or add an elevation shadow; inset outlines and legibility halos are the only shadows.
Don't use green for brand, links, buttons or success.
Don't load web fonts or bundled font files; the system stacks are the inventory.

Don't add icons or icon glyphs; marks are the textures, squares, outlines and corner triangles already in the grid. One exception, confirmed by the member 2026-09-14: the card's text action keeps its "→ " prefix before "View evidence".
Don't leave a visible empty ruled band where a section has no content.
Don't return to the Scout / Picture Desk petrol, Archivo and outline-icon vocabulary.
